lanes.label: your own AI engine
lanes.sub: your key, or your own endpoint
lanes.description: bring a provider key — Claude, Gemini, or GPT — or point sol at your own endpoint. it stays in your journal; sol pbc is never in the path.

lane_detail.heading: confidential processing
lane_detail.mechanism: sol pbc runs the model itself on confidential GPUs in Microsoft Azure. the hardware boundary keeps the cloud host excluded from what's processed — no third-party AI provider is in the path.
lane_detail.egress: when it's on, the thinking leaves your device — text, images, and (with the audio switch on, its default) your audio for transcription. your journal itself never leaves.
lane_detail.claims: no content is retained · no human reviews it · nothing is used to train
lane_detail.attestation: your journal must verify the service before anything is sent — if it can't verify, it doesn't send.
lane_detail.early_access: confidential processing is coming — scouts get it first.
